is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae sensu stricto, Anopheles arabiensis, and Anopheles funestus (page 3, section 2.1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for the Vgsc L995S (kdr-east) mutation (page 5, section 2.13; page 8, Table 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 (page 8) provides genotype frequencies (SS, LS, LL) and sample sizes for various clusters, collection methods, species, and years.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted on field-collected mosquitoes from Teso North and Teso South subcounties, Busia County, Kenya (page 3, section 2.1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field data on species composition, phenotypic resistance, and genotypic resistance.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides data at the subcounty (Teso North, Teso South) and cluster (Kaliwa, Odioi, Akiriamasit, Kengatunyi, Rwatama) levels (page 3, section 2.1; page 6, Table 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports data collected between 2012 and 2014 (page 6, Table 1; page 8, Table 4).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new, original field collection and analysis conducted between 2012 and 2014.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and frequencies, are provided in the main text tables (Table 3 and Table 4).

assessment.summary: This study investigated species composition, phenotypic resistance (WHO tube assays), and genotypic resistance (kdr L995S) in Anopheles mosquitoes in Teso North and Teso South subcounties, Kenya, between 2012 and 2014. The study found high levels of resistance to pyrethroids and susceptibility to bendiocarb.
